_comment: Provider registry in OmniCLI's field shape: env_key, alt_env_keys, base_url, base_url_template, default_model, requires_auth_for_models, fallback_models. That shape is deliberate - an OmniCLI config.json (OMNICLI_CONFIG_DIR) loads unmodified, so existing providers and keys are reused rather than duplicated. Keys never live in this file. No key is ever written to a config, a results file, or a receipt row.

nvidia.name: NVIDIA
nvidia._notes: The model RESULTS.md claims the World-1 arms used. Free tier throttles at HTTP 429; throttle below quota or the run degrades silently.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter._notes: One key, many models. Free tier is rate-limited; record the model id exactly.

groq.name: Groq
groq._notes: Free tier, fast, small context on some models.

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini._notes: OpenAI-COMPATIBLE endpoint. The native Gemini API is not compatible - use this base_url or write an adapter.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic._notes: OpenAI compatibility is partial. Verify tool-calling behaviour before trusting a run.

ollama.name: Ollama (local)
ollama._notes: Local, no key. Not comparable to a hosted arm unless BOTH arms use it - see the parity invariant.
